# ProFiler Suite

Canonical repository: https://github.com/file-bricks/ProFiler
Source version: 15.0.2 (frozen; no current release or Store approval is evidenced)

ProFiler Suite is a Windows-oriented PySide6 desktop application for working with user-selected local folders. It can build a SQLite search index, search documents, run OCR when external tools are available, perform selected PDF workflows, find duplicate files, and provide a pattern-based privacy review. The main GUI has six locale catalogs: English, German, Spanish, Simplified Chinese, Japanese, and Russian.

The reviewed first-party paths did not show automatic upload of selected document contents or telemetry. This is a bounded source observation, not an egress guarantee. The optional module installer can contact GitHub when explicitly invoked. ProFiler does not block outbound traffic, sandbox external programs, or control third-party libraries and tools.

## Main workflows

- Index user-selected folders into a local SQLite database and search the resulting index.
- Use OCR workflows when compatible host-installed Tesseract and Poppler tools are available.
- Use selected PDF utilities for encryption, decryption, page extraction, and text removal.
- Review pattern-based privacy matches and redactions before sharing; these features do not guarantee complete detection, anonymization, or legal compliance.
- Export or import a redacted workspace for review or handoff.
- Use `SQLiteViewer.py` to inspect a selected SQLite database.

Application settings and indexes use local paths whose exact locations depend on configuration and operating system. PDF passwords are excluded from the persisted application settings covered by the targeted regression tests; this is not a general guarantee for every secret or external process.

## Important files

- `README.md` and `README_de.md` — English and German product overview, workflows, and limitations.
- `SECURITY.md` — private vulnerability-reporting route and current response-policy scope; no response, triage, or remediation deadline is promised.
- `PRIVACY_POLICY.md` — bounded description of reviewed first-party data flows.
- `THIRD_PARTY_LICENSES.md` and `THIRD_PARTY_LICENSES.txt` — declared direct runtime/optional dependencies and selected build/development tools with upstream references. These are not a complete transitive inventory, binary bill of materials, or license-compatibility opinion.
- `LICENSE` and `NOTICE` — project license and attribution.
- `PLATFORM_SUPPORT.md` — source-platform evidence and its limits.
- `WINDOWS_STORE_PREP.md` — current Store/release gate and preparation boundary.
- `source_platform_smoke.py` and `tests/` — source checks and tests; see CI for the exact commit and platform results.
- `.github/workflows/source-platform-smoke.yml` — Ubuntu/macOS source workflow. It does not establish Windows behavior, native packaging, OCR/Poppler bundling, or Store/WACK approval.
- `github_installer.py` — optional GitHub module-installer utility; it is not a remote-control interface for the main GUI.
- `version.py` and `pyproject.toml` — current source and Python-package metadata (`15.0.2`).

## Distribution boundary

The Python wheel packages Python runtime modules, locale data, and selected icons; it is not a standalone native executable. The reviewed checkout lacks the Tesseract and Poppler files required by `build_exe.bat`, so the native executable build is currently blocked. No signed MSIX, current WACK result on a built package, or Store submission is evidenced. Staging files do not establish release approval.

The project is licensed under AGPL-3.0-only; see `LICENSE`. Review the exact artifact contents and included license texts before any binary redistribution. The dependency notes do not determine license compatibility.

## Related projects

- [ProSync](https://github.com/file-bricks/ProSync) — a separate companion program that ProFiler can launch from an optional menu item. Its synchronization runs outside ProFiler.
- [KnowledgeDigest](https://github.com/file-bricks/knowledgedigest) — a separate notes and knowledge-search tool; a direct ProFiler integration is not established.
- [PDFtoPDFocr](https://github.com/doc-bricks/PDFtoPDFocr) — a separate batch OCR and searchable-PDF tool; no direct integration is claimed.
- [DokuZen](https://github.com/doc-bricks/DokuZen) — a separate desktop PDF-workflow tool; no direct integration is claimed.

These are related projects with separate repositories and behavior. The links do not imply shared runtime, data exchange, or a broader integration.
